display_long_description:
You weren't supposed to end up here.

One wrong step and you've slipped out of reality into the Backrooms: an endless maze of damp yellow carpet, buzzing fluorescent lights, and hallways that never seem to end. There's no map and no clear way out. The only way forward is to keep moving.

Explore the Backrooms in VR with gorilla locomotion. Every level feels different. Wander through the classic yellow halls, get lost in silent flooded poolrooms, and push into darker, stranger places the deeper you go. Some rooms feel calm. Some feel wrong. Learning which is which is part of surviving.

Because you are not alone.

Somewhere in the dark, things are moving. You'll hear footsteps that aren't yours, distant noises echoing through the walls, and lights that flicker just before something shows up. When a monster spots you, there's no fighting back. Your only choice is to run for your life and hope it can't follow where you go.

How far can you make it before the Backrooms catch you?
